title_zh: 限定档案试办并安排复核

scenario.label_zh: 限定档案试办范围和复核承诺
scenario.goal_zh: 明确长期目标与当前小规模试办的区别，约定先测试检索并据结果决定是否扩展

context_zh: 档案团队讨论试办范围，避免承诺尚无依据的推广。
author: author-phase09-c

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: Our ultimate goal is to make the whole archive searchable, but can we undertake that much work this month?

sentences.speaker: Tess
sentences.text: No. There's still uncertainty about how well the scanner handles handwritten pages.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: Then let's start with one box. We can test whether people can find five named letters.

sentences.speaker: Tess
sentences.text: That would tell us more than simply counting scanned pages.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: Ultimately, the search results should decide whether we expand, not the launch date.

sentences.speaker: Tess
sentences.text: Agreed. I'll choose the box today and bring the search results to Friday's meeting.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: I'll write up that limited plan. We aren't promising the full archive yet.
